files.html: //! input_cursor_shapes - the cursor's shape over the window, and the window's title, changed while the app runs. //! //! Each tile names one of the engine's cursor shapes (raylib's set). Hovering a tile asks for its shape //! (`z.setMouseCursor`), and the window's title names it (`z.setWindowTitle`); the last tile hides the cursor while //! it is hovered (`z.hideCursor`). The app only says, each frame, which cursor it wants. The engine shows it through //! the platform once the frame's update is done - a CSS cursor in the browser, a system cursor in a native window - //! and only when it differs from the one shown, so asking every frame costs nothing. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const common = @import("example_common"); const zm = @import("zm"); const float = zm.float; const Color = zm.Color; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); /// One tile: its label, and the cursor it asks for - none for the tile that hides the cursor. const Tile = struct { label: []const u8, cursor: ?z.MouseCursor, }; const tiles = [_]Tile{ .{ .label = "default", .cursor = .default }, .{ .label = "ibeam", .cursor = .ibeam }, .{ .label = "pointing_hand", .cursor = .pointing_hand }, .{ .label = "crosshair", .cursor = .crosshair }, .{ .label = "resize_ew", .cursor = .resize_ew }, .{ .label = "resize_ns", .cursor = .resize_ns }, .{ .label = "resize_nwse", .cursor = .resize_nwse }, .{ .label = "resize_nesw", .cursor = .resize_nesw }, .{ .label = "resize_all", .cursor = .resize_all }, .{ .label = "not_allowed", .cursor = .not_allowed }, .{ .label = "hidden", .cursor = null }, }; const columns: usize = 4; const margin: f32 = 16; const gap: f32 = 10; const background: Color = .{ .r = 15, .g = 23, .b = 42, .a = 255 }; const tile_color: Color = .{ .r = 30, .g = 41, .b = 59, .a = 255 }; const hovered_color: Color = .{ .r = 51, .g = 65, .b = 85, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 226, .g = 232, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// The tile hovered in the previous frame, so the title changes only when the hovered tile does. hovered: ?usize = null, }; fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.* = .{ .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 18) }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// Tile `index`'s rectangle, in a grid of `columns` filling the window's width below the caption. fn tileRect(index: usize, width: f32) z.Rectangle { const tile_width: f32 = (width - 2 * margin - gap * float(columns - 1)) / float(columns); const tile_height: f32 = 64; const column: usize = index % columns; const row: usize = index / columns; return .{ .x = margin + float(column) * (tile_width + gap), .y = 48 + float(row) * (tile_height + gap), .width = tile_width, .height = tile_height, }; } fn isInside(rect: z.Rectangle, point: Vec2) bool { const is_within_columns: bool = point[0] >= rect.x and point[0] < rect.x + rect.width; const is_within_rows: bool = point[1] >= rect.y and point[1] < rect.y + rect.height; return is_within_columns and is_within_rows; } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const width: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const pointer: Vec2 = z.getMousePosition(f.input); var hovered: ?usize = null; for (tiles, 0..) |_, index| { if (isInside(tileRect(index, width), pointer)) { hovered = index; } } // The wish for this frame: the hovered tile's cursor, hidden for the last tile, the default elsewhere. const wanted: ?z.MouseCursor = if (hovered) |index| tiles[index].cursor else .default; if (wanted) |cursor| { z.showCursor(f.input); z.setMouseCursor(f.input, cursor); } else { z.hideCursor(f.input); } if (hovered != s.hovered) { s.hovered = hovered; const label: []const u8 = if (hovered) |index| tiles[index].label else "none"; const title: z.Str(64) = .print("zimr - cursor: {s}", .{label}); z.setWindowTitle(title.slice()); } z.clearViewport(f, background); for (tiles, 0..) |tile, index| { const rect: z.Rectangle = tileRect(index, width); const color: Color = if (hovered == index) hovered_color else tile_color; f.gl.rect(rect, .{ .color = color }); f.gl.text(.{ rect.x + 12, rect.y + 22 }, tile.label, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "input_cursor_shapes: hover a tile to show its cursor; the title names it"); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - cursor: none", .width = 820, .height = 360, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
